2291:# Quietline

Encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet.

Addresses never appear on the message. Content decrypts only on the
recipient's device. A private transfer can carry a memo in the same
transaction —
summary: Create encrypted on-chain mail on Starknet.
description_long: The project allows users to send encrypted messages on Starknet without revealing sender or recipient identities. It utilizes a `privacy_invoke` helper to ensure that only the intended recipient can decrypt the message, while also enabling optional payment memos within the same transaction. The challenge lies in maintaining privacy in a public blockchain environment while ensuring functionality and user-friendliness.
latest_push: Pivoted Feltproof to Quietline, integrating private mail on STRK20.
